lines.t: The time has come, the veil is torn
Thunder whispers, a new world is born
The heavens speak, the earth replies
Revelation burns across the skies
The floodgates open, truth falls down
The sleepers rise from the silent ground
What once was hidden now takes its stand
The breath of life moves through the land
Pour it out, spirit of fire
On sons and daughters filled with desire Dreams will rise, visions unfold
The ancient promise at last we've told
Storehouses open, light breaks through Old hearts stirred with dreams made new
Voices of prophecy fill the air Echoes of glory everywhere
Awaken the sleepers, call them by name Kindle the embers into flame
Your word runs swift, your will is known
Heaven and earth move as one
Pour it out, spirit of fire
On sons and daughters filled with desire
Dreams will arise, visions unfold
The ancient promise at last retold
So let it be, in these last days
Your spirit flowing in endless waves
The time has come, the truth made bright
The dawn of glory, the end of night
Thank you for watching!
